name: Unidentified J-type 327 Nubian starship
description: A J-type 327 Nubian starship was a vessel whose downed remains were located on the Outer Rim Territories planet Genbara. Twenty years after the Sith rebellion, the J-type 327 Nubian royal starship could be seen embedded in the mountains near a rural settlement. When the former Sith known as "the Ronin" and his astromech droid R5-D56 passed through the region, they observed the derelict yacht from afar and later encountered a former Jedi known as "the Traveler" playing the flute near the ship as they departed the area.
